kept.excerpt: At least seven Democrats are competing for the nomination to take on Republican Sen. Susan Collins. The process is poised to culminate with a party convention in Bangor on July 25, two days before state law requires the Maine Democratic Party to select a new nominee. Our Revolution has endorsed Troy Jackson for Senate.
kept.relevance: Provides the latest verified status at the cutoff, showing Jackson competing in an unresolved field with progressive organizational support.

kept.excerpt: Jackson leads the field at 40%, followed by Nirav Shah at 23% and Shenna Bellows at 14% with 10% undecided. When limited to just the top three options, 44% of voters select Jackson, 28% Shah, and 16% Bellows. This survey was conducted July 9–10, 2026, with a sample size of 884 and a margin of error of +/- 3.4% after accounting for weighting.
kept.relevance: Supplies direct polling evidence of Jackson's lead among Democratic primary voters, while the eventual selection mechanism is a delegate convention.

kept.excerpt: Graham Platner on Friday submitted his paperwork to formally withdraw from Maine's U.S. Senate race. The Maine Democratic Party announced later Friday that it will hold a nominating convention on July 25 to choose Platner's replacement for the November ballot. Platner's paperwork was received by the Maine secretary of state's office Friday afternoon.
kept.relevance: Establishes that Platner formally withdrew before the July 13 deadline, activating the replacement pathway specified in the resolution rules.

kept.excerpt: Maine Democrats have issued a call to hold a nominating convention on July 25, during which 601 delegates will vote on the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate. To be eligible, candidates must be registered Democratic voters, file a written Declaration of Intent to Seek the Democratic Nomination with the party chair, and collect 500 nominating signatures from individuals registered as Maine Democrats as of the June 9 primary.
kept.relevance: The designated resolution authority confirms the selection date, electorate and candidate qualification requirements.

kept.excerpt: This two-step process includes a Special Nominating Meeting in each county to select delegates followed by an in-person State Nominating Convention. Delegates will select the Democratic candidate for U.S. Senate. The State Nominating Convention will be Saturday July 25 starting at 9:00 AM at the Cross Insurance Center in Bangor.
kept.relevance: A dated official county-party notice confirms that county delegate selection precedes the convention and explains how voter support can translate into the nomination.

kept.excerpt: Our Revolution is throwing its support behind Jackson, a logger and former state senator who lost in the Democratic gubernatorial primary. The group, which endorsed Jackson last week, is hosting a virtual rally featuring Jackson alongside Michigan Senate candidate Abdul el-Sayed on Monday night. Rep. Ro Khanna backed Jackson last Thursday and will lead the organizing and fundraising event.
kept.relevance: Documents endorsements and fundraising infrastructure available to Jackson during the compressed nomination contest.

kept.excerpt: Nirav Shah announced that his campaign had collected more than 800 signatures, surpassing the threshold required to qualify for the Maine Democratic Party's nominating convention. He said the campaign exceeded the requirement of at least 500 signatures overall, including a minimum of 50 signatures from each of eight counties. The Democratic nominating convention is scheduled for July 25 in Bangor.
kept.relevance: Shows that Jackson faced an organized rival reporting sufficient qualifying signatures before the cutoff, rather than an uncontested nomination.
